name: Segment-Box Collision Detection with Radius
definition: Determines if a line segment from point a to point b intersects a box defined by lower corner lo and upper corner hi, considering a spherical radius around the segment.
summary: Segment-Box Collision Detection with Radius determines if a thick segment intersects an axis-aligned box, distinguishing itself from standard ray-box intersection by treating the segment as a capsule with a spherical radius.
